fields.v: Gao, H., Banyongrakkul, P., Cheong, M., Treude, C., Baltes, S., Zahedi, M. (2026). Ethics by Configuration: AI Ethics Principles in Coding Agent Instructions. arXiv:2610.34847v1 [cs.SE], 26 Oct 2026
Preprint — arXiv:2610.34847v1 [cs.SE]; no venue stated
The University of Melbourne (Gao, Banyongrakkul, Cheong, Zahedi); Singapore Management University (Treude); Heidelberg University (Baltes)

Evaluates — empirical repository-mining study of AI ethics principles (Australia's 8 principles) in 40,079 agent configuration files from 8,893 GitHub repositories: two-LLM section classification validated against human annotation, plus qualitative thematic analysis of 702 samples across 679 files. No agent run
fields.why: Observational mining study of configuration files; no approach or configuration evaluated, so no listed nature fits exactly. 'Evaluates' kept as closest; the first stated contribution is a validated LLM classification approach (p. 2), so a secondary 'Proposes an evaluation method' could be argued. Author to apply one rule to this and the other mining studies (e.g. rayyan-800485930)

Prevalence of ethics-related statements per file and repository, by principle (Australia's AI Ethics Principles, 8) and mechanism; repository principle coverage; 30 categories / 125 codes of ethical considerations; parties mentioned. Classifier validity: precision, recall, F1, Cohen's kappa

Construct: content alignment with principles may capture SE practice; overlapping principles. Internal: LLM classification may miss statements (recall estimated from Stage 1 predictions); single coder after calibration; hooks/settings may express ethics in code (underestimated); only explicit parties. External: public GitHub only, five tools as of Aug 2026. Gap: whether agents follow such instructions is untested; propose benchmarks of ethical behaviour, mining of disclosure, longitudinal studies of instruction maintenance (as for SDD specs)

Table III and Fig. 2-4 partly jumbled by pdftotext; values quoted from the text where possible. Dataset extends Galster et al. (15,591 artefacts, 4,738 repos, Mar 2026) by re-running their pipeline. Replication package: zenodo.org/records/23595425. No pre-registration. Programming language: not applicable (mixed repositories). Relevance to SDD: context-file mechanisms only; no agent outcome
